texts:
His grandfather ran a diner for thirty years, and the grill still hangs above the stove in his own apartment. He makes hash browns the old way, with onions cooked low until they turn sweet. Money is never easy, so he buys the cheap cuts and treats them with care. The dog waits patiently under the table for a bite.
Thanks,
Jules
